fields.name: WordFall: Word Games
fields.description:
Follow the letters in WordFall! Join Wiffle, explore different word puzzles and work toward your next personal best.

VURGUN: WORD HUNT
Dive deep, catch the right letters in order and complete the word. Manage your oxygen, dodge obstacles and aim for a higher score.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Explore Word Crush, Word Tetris and daily word puzzles. Connect letters, use clues and discover new words.

A NEW GOAL EACH DAY
Take on daily challenges or compete against other players in Word Bomb online. Use all the letters to make a word before time runs out.

WORDS IN FIVE LANGUAGES
Play with English, Turkish, German, French and Spanish words. Choose your word language and put your vocabulary to the test.

A quick break or a longer puzzle session: find your next word in WordFall.

Track your position on the leaderboards. An optional subscription offers unlimited lives.

Privacy Policy: https://wordfall.org/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
